item.title: Making digital forms accessible
item.description: Build vocabulary for testing whether people can read, understand and complete a digital form. Describe changes without assuming every user uses a mouse or can see the screen.

children.definition: Software that presents on-screen text and controls through speech or Braille.
children.example: The tester used a screen reader to check whether each form button had a useful name.
children.translation_ru: программа экранного доступа, озвучивающая интерфейс или выводящая его на дисплей Брайля
children.translation_uz: ekrandagi matn va boshqaruv elementlarini ovoz yoki Brayl orqali yetkazadigan dastur

children.definition: A strong difference between light and dark areas that makes text or objects easier to distinguish.
children.example: The form uses high contrast so the labels stand out against the background.

children.definition: A written description that gives users the important meaning of an image when they cannot see it.
children.example: We added alternative text to explain what the diagram shows about the waiting area.
children.translation_uz: tasvirning muhim mazmunini tushuntiradigan muqobil matn

children.definition: A written record of the words spoken in a recording or event.
children.example: The video page links to a transcript of the instructions.
children.translation_uz: yozuvdagi yoki tadbirdagi nutqning yozma matni

children.example: The date stays readable when I make the text larger on my phone.

children.definition: The process or controls for moving between parts of a site or app.
children.example: The team simplified the navigation so a learner can reach the help page in one step.
children.translation_uz: sayt yoki ilova boʻlimlari boʻylab oʻtish

children.definition: Something that prevents people from using a service or taking part.
children.example: A required phone call can be a barrier for someone who cannot hear the automated instructions.
children.translation_uz: xizmatdan foydalanishga yoki ishtirok etishga toʻsqinlik qiladigan holat

children.definition: Able to be changed to suit a person’s needs or preferences.
children.example: The adjustable line spacing helped Sam read the form more comfortably.

children.definition: The practice of showing spoken words and important sounds as text at the same time as a video or live event.
children.example: The workshop recording uses captioning to identify speakers and show when the alarm rings.
children.translation_ru: добавление синхронных субтитров с речью и важными звуками
children.translation_uz: nutq va muhim tovushlarni video bilan bir vaqtda matnda koʻrsatish

children.definition: The sequence in which the focus moves through controls when a user presses the Tab key.
children.example: The submit button comes after the last field in the tab order.
children.translation_ru: порядок перехода между элементами по клавише Tab
children.translation_uz: Tab tugmasi bosilganda fokusning elementlar boʻylab oʻtish tartibi

children.definition: A key or combination of keys that performs a particular action quickly.
children.example: The guide lists a keyboard shortcut for opening the search box.
children.translation_ru: сочетание клавиш для быстрого выполнения команды
children.translation_uz: amalni tez bajaradigan klavish yoki klavishlar birikmasi

children.definition: Equipment or software that helps a person with a disability carry out a task.
children.example: A tester used assistive technology to select form options with a switch instead of a mouse.
children.translation_ru: ассистивные технологии для людей с инвалидностью
children.translation_uz: nogironligi boʻlgan kishilarga vazifani bajarishda yordam beradigan texnologiya

children.definition: A visible marker that shows which on-screen control will respond to keyboard input.
children.example: A thick blue focus indicator appears around the button I have reached with Tab.
children.translation_ru: видимый указатель фокуса на активном элементе интерфейса
children.translation_uz: klaviatura orqali boshqarilayotgan elementni koʻrsatadigan koʻrinadigan belgi

children.definition: Clear, direct wording that the intended reader can understand without extra explanation.
children.example: The team rewrote the error message in plain language and explained how to fix the date.
children.translation_uz: oʻquvchiga tushunarli, sodda va aniq til
